package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

// Host primitive boundaries: no CUDA/Metal allocation, transfer or sync occurs.
var Flash = struct{ Embed, Layers, Vocab, SlidingWindow int }{4096, 43, 129280, 128}
var fixtureErrClosed = errors.New("closed")
var fixtureErrDesynchronized = errors.New("desynchronized")
var fixtureFault = errors.New("host fixture fault")

const cudaStateMaxBytes = 1 << 30
const metalStateMaxBytes = 1 << 30
const cudaStateHeaderBytes = 104
const metalStateHeaderSize = 32

var cudaStateMagic = [8]byte{'C', 'O', 'R', 'E', 'C', 'U', 'D', 'A'}

const metalStateMagic = "COREMETL"

type hostBuffer[T any] struct {
	data []T
	fail bool
}

func (b hostBuffer[T]) Len() int { return len(b.data) }
func (b hostBuffer[T]) CopyToHost(dst []T) error {
	if b.fail {
		return fixtureFault
	}
	copy(dst, b.data)
	return nil
}
func (b hostBuffer[T]) CopyFromHost(src []T) error {
	if b.fail {
		return fixtureFault
	}
	copy(b.data, src)
	return nil
}

type cudaDSparkFeatureSnapshot struct {
	owner             *cudaDSparkFeatures
	modelSHA          string
	context, block    int
	targets           []int
	history, features hostBuffer[float32]
	status            hostBuffer[uint32]
	journal           *dsparkFeatureJournal
	generation        uint64
	position, token   int
	published         bool
	captured          []bool
}
type cudaDSparkFeatures struct {
	modelSHA string
	r        *cudaRuntime
	block    int
	targets  []int
	value    *dsparkSupportEnvelope
}
type fixtureObserver struct{ invalidations int }

func (o *fixtureObserver) invalidate() { o.invalidations++ }

type cudaRuntime struct {
	ctx          int
	core         []byte
	failed       error
	headObserver fixtureObserver
}

func (*cudaRuntime) stream() int { return 0 }
func syncStream(int) error       { return nil }

type cudaRequestState struct {
	runtime                    *cudaRuntime
	dspark                     *cudaDSparkFeatures
	generation, lifecycleEpoch uint64
}
type cudaStateSnapshot struct {
	owner                      *cudaRuntime
	dspark                     *cudaDSparkFeatureSnapshot
	core                       []byte
	pos                        int
	generation                 uint64
	closed, closing, failClose bool
	closes                     int
}
type cudaSupportLoadHooks struct {
	snapshot                                      func() (io.Closer, error)
	afterStageTransfer, afterCore, beforeRollback func() error
}

func (v *cudaStateSnapshot) Close() error {
	v.closes++
	if v.failClose {
		v.failClose = false
		return fixtureFault
	}
	v.closed = true
	return nil
}
func fixtureEnvelope(v *cudaDSparkFeatureSnapshot) *dsparkSupportEnvelope {
	e, _ := cudaSupportIdentity(v.modelSHA, v.context, v.block, v.targets)
	e.history = append([]float32(nil), v.history.data...)
	e.journal = v.journal.clone()
	e.capture = &dsparkSupportCapture{generation: v.generation, position: v.position, token: v.token, published: v.published, captured: append([]bool(nil), v.captured...), status: v.status.data[0], features: append([]float32(nil), v.features.data...)}
	return e
}
func (f *cudaDSparkFeatures) validateSnapshot(v *cudaDSparkFeatureSnapshot, pos int, generation uint64) error {
	return fixtureEnvelope(v).validate(pos, generation)
}
func (f *cudaDSparkFeatures) restore(v *cudaDSparkFeatureSnapshot, pos int, generation uint64) error {
	f.value = fixtureEnvelope(v)
	return nil
}
func fixtureNoRestore(*cudaDSparkFeatureSnapshot, int, uint64) error { return nil }
func (s *cudaRequestState) Snapshot() (io.Closer, error) {
	e := s.dspark.value
	c := e.capture
	v := &cudaDSparkFeatureSnapshot{owner: s.dspark, modelSHA: s.dspark.modelSHA, context: e.context, block: e.block, targets: append([]int(nil), e.targets...), history: hostBuffer[float32]{data: append([]float32(nil), e.history...)}, features: hostBuffer[float32]{data: append([]float32(nil), c.features...)}, status: hostBuffer[uint32]{data: []uint32{c.status}}, journal: e.journal.clone(), generation: c.generation, position: c.position, token: c.token, published: c.published, captured: append([]bool(nil), c.captured...)}
	return &cudaStateSnapshot{owner: s.runtime, dspark: v, core: bytes.Clone(s.runtime.core), pos: e.journal.frontier, generation: s.generation}, nil
}
func (s *cudaRequestState) restoreSnapshot(v *cudaStateSnapshot) error {
	s.runtime.core = bytes.Clone(v.core)
	s.dspark.value = fixtureEnvelope(v.dspark)
	s.generation = v.generation
	return nil
}
func (s *cudaRequestState) completeObservedCacheReplacement(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		s.lifecycleEpoch++
	}
	return err
}
func writeCUDAStateCoreSnapshot(w io.Writer, v *cudaStateSnapshot, model, quant [32]byte) error {
	_, err := w.Write(v.core)
	return err
}
func loadCUDAState(s *cudaRequestState, r io.Reader) error {
	b, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	if err == nil {
		s.runtime.core = b
	}
	return err
}

type metalModel struct {
	sha256 string
	block  int
}
type metalWeights struct{ model *metalModel }
type metalDSparkFeatureSnapshot struct {
	owner          *metalDSparkFeatures
	modelSHA       string
	context, block int
	targets        []int
	journal        *dsparkFeatureJournal
	data           []float32
}
type metalDSparkFeatures struct {
	weights *metalWeights
	targets []int
	value   *dsparkSupportEnvelope
}

func (f *metalDSparkFeatures) validateSnapshot(v *metalDSparkFeatureSnapshot, pos int) error {
	e, err := metalSupportEnvelope(v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return e.validate(pos, 0)
}
func (f *metalDSparkFeatures) publishSnapshot(v *metalDSparkFeatureSnapshot) {
	f.value, _ = metalSupportEnvelope(v)
}
func fixtureNoPublish(*metalDSparkFeatureSnapshot) {}

type metalRuntime struct {
	ctx              int
	speculativeEpoch uint64
	dsparkFeatures   *metalDSparkFeatures
	core             []byte
	failLoad         bool
}
type metalRequestState struct{ runtime *metalRuntime }
type metalSnapshot struct {
	data   []byte
	dspark *metalDSparkFeatureSnapshot
	closed bool
}

func writeMetalStateFull(w io.Writer, b []byte) error { _, err := w.Write(b); return err }
func loadMetalState(s *metalRuntime, r io.Reader) error {
	if s.failLoad {
		return fixtureFault
	}
	b, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	if err == nil {
		s.core = b
	}
	return err
}

func fixtureCore(cuda bool, pos int, marker byte) []byte {
	if cuda {
		b := make([]byte, cudaStateHeaderBytes+1)
		copy(b, cudaStateMagic[:])
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[12:20], uint64(pos))
		b[len(b)-1] = marker
		return b
	}
	b := make([]byte, metalStateHeaderSize+1)
	copy(b, metalStateMagic)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b[16:24], uint64(pos))
	b[len(b)-1] = marker
	return b
}
func fixtureCUDA(t *testing.T, e *dsparkSupportEnvelope, generation uint64, marker byte) *cudaRequestState {
	r := &cudaRuntime{ctx: e.context, core: fixtureCore(true, e.journal.frontier, marker)}
	f := &cudaDSparkFeatures{modelSHA: hex.EncodeToString(e.model[:]), r: r, block: e.block, targets: e.targets, value: e}
	return &cudaRequestState{runtime: r, dspark: f, generation: generation, lifecycleEpoch: 4}
}
func fixtureMetal(e *dsparkSupportEnvelope, marker byte) *metalRequestState {
	f := &metalDSparkFeatures{weights: &metalWeights{&metalModel{hex.EncodeToString(e.model[:]), e.block}}, targets: e.targets, value: e}
	return &metalRequestState{&metalRuntime{ctx: e.context, core: fixtureCore(false, e.journal.frontier, marker), dsparkFeatures: f, speculativeEpoch: 4}}
}
func fixtureOriginal(t *testing.T, e *dsparkSupportEnvelope, core []byte, generation uint64) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	var b bytes.Buffer
	if err := writeRetainedDSparkSupportContainer(&b, core, e, e.journal.frontier, generation, 1<<30); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b.Bytes()
}
func TestCallerWrites(t *testing.T) {
	for _, cuda := range []bool{true, false} {
		for _, wrapped := range []bool{false, true} {
			e, _, generation := supportCodecFixture(t, cuda, wrapped)
			core := fixtureCore(cuda, e.journal.frontier, 17)
			want := fixtureOriginal(t, e, core, generation)
			var got bytes.Buffer
			if cuda {
				s := fixtureCUDA(t, e, generation, 17)
				v, err := s.Snapshot()
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				s.dspark.modelSHA = ""
				s.dspark.value = nil
				s.runtime = nil
				if err := writeCUDASupportSnapshot(&got, v.(*cudaStateSnapshot), [32]byte{}, [32]byte{}); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !bytes.Equal(got.Bytes(), want) {
					t.Fatal("cuda caller omitted or changed original container bytes")
				}
			} else {
				v := &metalSnapshot{data: core, dspark: &metalDSparkFeatureSnapshot{modelSHA: hex.EncodeToString(e.model[:]), context: e.context, block: e.block, targets: e.targets, journal: e.journal, data: e.history}}
				if err := writeMetalStateSnapshot(&got, v); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !bytes.Equal(got.Bytes(), want) {
					t.Fatal("metal caller omitted or changed original container bytes")
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
func TestCallerLoads(t *testing.T) {
	for _, cuda := range []bool{true, false} {
		e, _, generation := supportCodecFixture(t, cuda, false)
		destination, _, _ := supportCodecFixture(t, cuda, false)
		destination.history[0] = -9
		core := fixtureCore(cuda, e.journal.frontier, 23)
		data := fixtureOriginal(t, e, core, generation)
		if cuda {
			s := fixtureCUDA(t, destination, generation, 5)
			if err := s.loadSupportWithHooks(bytes.NewReader(data), nil); err != nil {
				t.Fatal("cuda caller failed original envelope load", err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(s.dspark.value, e) || !bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, core) || s.generation != generation || s.lifecycleEpoch != 5 {
				t.Fatal("cuda caller did not publish support values")
			}
		} else {
			s := fixtureMetal(destination, 5)
			if err := s.loadSupport(bytes.NewReader(data)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal("metal caller failed original envelope load", err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(s.runtime.dsparkFeatures.value, e) || !bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, core) || s.runtime.speculativeEpoch != 5 {
				t.Fatal("metal caller did not publish support values")
			}
		}
	}
}
func TestCallerFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, cuda := range []bool{true, false} {
		e, _, generation := supportCodecFixture(t, cuda, false)
		foreign, _, _ := supportCodecFixture(t, cuda, false)
		foreign.model[0]++
		data := fixtureOriginal(t, foreign, fixtureCore(cuda, e.journal.frontier, 23), generation)
		if cuda {
			s := fixtureCUDA(t, e, generation, 5)
			before := bytes.Clone(s.runtime.core)
			if err := s.loadSupportWithHooks(bytes.NewReader(data), nil); err == nil || !bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, before) || s.dspark.value != e || s.lifecycleEpoch != 4 {
				t.Fatal("cuda foreign load mutated destination")
			}
			data = fixtureOriginal(t, e, fixtureCore(true, e.journal.frontier, 23), generation)
			if err := s.loadSupportWithHooks(bytes.NewReader(data), &cudaSupportLoadHooks{afterCore: func() error { return fixtureFault }}); !errors.Is(err, fixtureFault) || !bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, before) || !reflect.DeepEqual(s.dspark.value, e) || s.lifecycleEpoch != 4 {
				t.Fatal("cuda caller rollback lost destination", err)
			}
			if err := s.loadSupportWithHooks(bytes.NewReader(data), &cudaSupportLoadHooks{beforeRollback: func() error { return fixtureFault }, afterCore: func() error { return fixtureFault }}); !errors.Is(err, fixtureErrDesynchronized) || s.runtime.failed == nil || s.runtime.headObserver.invalidations != 1 {
				t.Fatal("cuda caller failed rollback did not poison", err)
			}
		} else {
			s := fixtureMetal(e, 5)
			before := bytes.Clone(s.runtime.core)
			if err := s.loadSupport(bytes.NewReader(data)); err == nil || !bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, before) || s.runtime.dsparkFeatures.value != e || s.runtime.speculativeEpoch != 4 {
				t.Fatal("metal foreign load mutated destination")
			}
			s.runtime.failLoad = true
			data = fixtureOriginal(t, e, fixtureCore(false, e.journal.frontier, 23), generation)
			if err := s.loadSupport(bytes.NewReader(data)); !errors.Is(err, fixtureFault) || s.runtime.dsparkFeatures.value != e || s.runtime.speculativeEpoch != 4 {
				t.Fatal("metal failed core load published support", err)
			}
		}
	}
}
func TestCallerOwner(t *testing.T) {
	e, _, generation := supportCodecFixture(t, true, false)
	s := fixtureCUDA(t, e, generation, 5)
	before := bytes.Clone(s.runtime.core)
	data := fixtureOriginal(t, e, fixtureCore(true, e.journal.frontier, 23), generation)
	var stage *cudaStateSnapshot
	hooks := &cudaSupportLoadHooks{snapshot: func() (io.Closer, error) {
		v, err := s.Snapshot()
		stage = v.(*cudaStateSnapshot)
		stage.failClose = true
		stage.dspark.history.fail = true
		return v, err
	}}
	err := s.loadSupportWithHooks(bytes.NewReader(data), hooks)
	var owner io.Closer
	if !errors.Is(err, fixtureFault) || !errors.As(err, &owner) || !bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, before) || s.dspark.value != e || s.lifecycleEpoch != 4 {
		t.Fatal("cuda caller lost retryable cleanup owner", err)
	}
	if err := owner.Close(); err != nil || stage.closes != 2 {
		t.Fatal("cuda retained owner retry failed", err)
	}
	if err := owner.Close(); err != nil || stage.closes != 2 {
		t.Fatal("cuda retained owner repeated close", err)
	}
	for _, failCore := range []bool{false, true} {
		s = fixtureCUDA(t, e, generation, 5)
		before = bytes.Clone(s.runtime.core)
		var snapshots []*cudaStateSnapshot
		hooks = &cudaSupportLoadHooks{snapshot: func() (io.Closer, error) {
			v, err := s.Snapshot()
			native := v.(*cudaStateSnapshot)
			snapshots = append(snapshots, native)
			if len(snapshots) == 2 {
				native.failClose = true
			}
			return v, err
		}}
		if failCore {
			hooks.afterCore = func() error { return fixtureFault }
		}
		err = s.loadSupportWithHooks(bytes.NewReader(data), hooks)
		owner = nil
		if !errors.Is(err, fixtureFault) || !errors.As(err, &owner) || len(snapshots) != 2 {
			t.Fatal("cuda backup cleanup owner lost", err)
		}
		if failCore && (!bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, before) || s.lifecycleEpoch != 4) {
			t.Fatal("cuda failed operation cleanup changed destination")
		}
		if !failCore && (!bytes.Equal(s.runtime.core, fixtureCore(true, e.journal.frontier, 23)) || s.lifecycleEpoch != 5) {
			t.Fatal("cuda successful load cleanup lost committed destination")
		}
		if err := owner.Close(); err != nil || snapshots[0].closes != 1 || snapshots[1].closes != 2 {
			t.Fatal("cuda backup cleanup retry failed", err)
		}
		if err := owner.Close(); err != nil || snapshots[0].closes != 1 || snapshots[1].closes != 2 {
			t.Fatal("cuda backup cleanup repeated close", err)
		}
	}
}
